contentEn:
In Greater Vancouver bathroom renovations, plumbing typically runs $2,500–$18,000 depending on scope. A simple vanity replacement costs $2,500–$5,000. Moving a toilet or adding a second sink can push costs to $8,000–$18,000. These figures come from Reno Stars project invoices across Richmond, Vancouver, North Vancouver and Burnaby in 2025–2026.

Bathroom Plumbing Cost Table — Greater Vancouver 2026

Work TypeCost Range (CAD)
Vanity drain/connect (no wall work)$800–$1,800
Replace faucet, shower valve, drain$1,500–$3,500
Rough-in for new bathroom$3,000–$6,000
Full re-pipe (copper or PEX)$4,500–$12,000
Water heater replacement (tank)$1,500–$3,500
Tankless water heater install$4,000–$8,000
Shower pan + linear drain$1,200–$2,800

Costs vary by city — Richmond and Burnaby permit fees are slightly lower than West Vancouver. All prices include materials and labour.

Do You Need a Licensed Plumber in BC?

Yes. Any work connecting to the potable water supply, drain-waste-vent (DWV) system, or natural gas line in BC must be performed or inspected by a licensed plumber. Reno Stars coordinates licensed plumbers as part of every bathroom renovation.

Bathroom Plumbing Permits in Greater Vancouver

  • Vancouver: Plumbing permit for any DWV modification, ~$150–$300 per fixture.
  • Richmond / Burnaby / Coquitlam: Permit for new or relocated fixtures, ~$100–$250 per fixture.
  • North Van / West Van: Plumbing permit plus building permit if walls are opened, combined $300–$600.
  • Delta / Surrey: Separate plumbing and building permits, charged per fixture.

Reno Stars obtains all permits as part of standard project management.

Where Plumbing Fits in Your Renovation Timeline

  1. Demolition (Days 1–3): Remove finishes, expose existing pipes.
  2. Rough-in (Days 3–7): Licensed plumber installs new supply and DWV pipes before insulation and drywall — the only chance to modify pipes without opening finished walls.
  3. Inspection (Days 7–10): City inspector reviews plumbing and electrical rough-in. Must pass before insulation and drywall.
  4. Insulation + vapour barrier (Days 10–14)
  5. Drywall (Days 14–18)
  6. Finish plumbing (Days 18–22): Faucets, shower valve, toilet — final connections after walls are sealed.
  7. Final inspection

Hot Water Tank vs. Tankless

Doing both simultaneously during a bathroom renovation saves money — one permit, one plumber visit. Reno Stars coordinates both scopes together.

Real Project Examples from Reno Stars

Richmond main bathroom: Full re-pipe (PEX), new shower pan, linear drain, fixture replacement. Total: $9,400 incl. permit and inspection.

North Vancouver ensuite: Move toilet 1.2m, add second sink, full rough-in. Total: $14,200 incl. permit.

Burnaby guest bathroom: Cosmetic refresh — vanity, faucet, shower valve, toilet. No wall opening. Total: $3,850 incl. permit.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I move a toilet during a bathroom renovation?

Yes, but it is expensive — typically $3,000–$8,000 extra because it may require cutting the concrete floor. Reno Stars confirms drain feasibility before including toilet relocation in any scope.

How long does bathroom plumbing take?

Rough-in plumbing: 3–5 working days. Finish plumbing after drywall: 1–2 days. Permit processing adds 5–10 business days before rough-in can begin.

contentZh:
在大溫浴室裝修中，管道工程費用通常在$2,500至$18,000加元之間，具體取決於工程範圍。簡單更換浴室櫃費用約$2,500至$5,000。移動馬桶或增加第二個洗手池可攀升至$8,000至$18,000。這些數據來源於Reno Stars 2025–2026年在列治文、溫哥華、北溫及本拿比的真實工程發票。

大溫浴室管道費用表 — 2026年

工程類型費用（加元）
浴室櫃排水/連接$800–$1,800
更換龍頭、淋浴閥、排水管$1,500–$3,500
新浴室管道預裝$3,000–$6,000
全屋改管（銅管或PEX）$4,500–$12,000
儲水式熱水器更換$1,500–$3,500
即熱式熱水器安裝$4,000–$8,000
淋浴底盤 + 線性地漏$1,200–$2,800

費用因城市而異。所有價格均包含材料和人工。

BC省是否需要持牌水管工？

是的——任何涉及供水系統、排水排氣管或天然氣管道的工程，必須由持牌水管工進行或接受檢驗。Reno Stars協調持牌水管工作為每個浴室裝修的標準流程。

大溫管道許可證

  • 溫哥華：$150–$300/每裝置
  • 列治文/本拿比/高貴林：$100–$250/每裝置
  • 北溫/西溫：管道+建築許可，$300–$600
  • Delta/Surrey：按裝置數量收費

Reno Stars代為辦理所有許可證。

管道工程時間線

  1. 拆除（第1-3天）
  2. 管道預裝（第3-7天）：持牌水管工在隔熱和石膏板之前鋪設新管道——這是唯一可以在不破壞已完工牆面的情況下修改管道的時機。
  3. 檢驗（第7-10天）
  4. 隔熱+防潮層（第10-14天）
  5. 石膏板（第14-18天）
  6. 管道收尾（第18-22天）：龍頭、淋浴閥、馬桶——牆面封閉後的最終連接。

Reno Stars真實案例

列治文主浴室：全屋改管（PEX）、新淋浴底盤、線性地漏。總價：$9,400含許可證和檢驗。

北溫套房浴室：馬桶移位1.2米、增設第二洗手池。總價：$14,200含許可證。

本拿比客房浴室：美化更新，無牆面開牆。總價：$3,850含許可證。

常見問題

裝修期間可以移動馬桶嗎？

可以，但通常增加$3,000至$8,000的費用，因為可能需要切割混凝土地板。Reno Stars在任何工程報價前都會確認排水的可行性。

浴室管道工程需要多長時間？

管道預裝：3–5個工作日。管道收尾：1–2天。許可證處理在管道預裝開始前增加5–10個工作日。
